title: CHEPTA-Lab's methanol column (Campos et al. 2022) with the vapour + liquid condenser at 53 C, Peng-Robinson
purpose: Proposal 0026, case 3: a real mixture with gases. The column of validation/data/columns/lab-requests-0.6.2/u-column-partial-pr.request.json (Lab's inputs, copied unchanged there) with condenser "vapour_liquid" at the paper's 326.15 K (53 C) and reflux ratio 2 (L1 / U1), and Lab's bottoms flow, solved by the engine and by this reference with the same Peng-Robinson. The paper's Aspen Plus numbers (gas distillate 289 kmol/h, liquid distillate 4542 kmol/h) are Lab's comparison, for information, not a validation: another program and other parameters.
method_choice: Peng-Robinson for both phases: a polar liquid with light gases at 100 kPa (docs/METHOD_SELECTION.md); Lab's own choice, kept as in its request file

campos_2022_aspen.source: Campos et al. 2022 (MDPI, open access), as read by CHEPTA-Lab: cases/methanol-co2-campos-2022/CAPABILITY_REQUESTS.md, request M5 (branch claude/lab-methanol-campos-run, read 2026-11-18); not a validation

engine_against_reference.why: Set from the run (proposal 0026): the two Peng-Robinson implementations, with the same databank k_ij(T) = k + kb/T and the feed's enthalpy from the reference's own flash, agree to about 1e-10 K and 1e-11 in mole fraction on this column; the tolerances are those of A3 (the solvers' convergence).
